judged_text: minimumTokenResponseSchema computed keys are nonsense: [z.string().toString()] and [z.string().optional().toString()] both evaluate to the literal string "[object Object]" (the second overwrites the first), so the intended "any numeric property is the expiry / allow other properties" schema never exists; since zod objects strip unknown keys, sync-mode parsed output contains only access_token — e.g. office365 never receives a new expiry_date, so the credential is perpetually "expired" and the sync endpoint is hit on every calendar operation (parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:5-11)
